newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore oil products mixed on steady crude.
newsitem.headline: Singapore oil products mixed on steady crude.

text.p: Singapore oil products market was mixed on Thursday with physical gas oil being discussed higher while swaps were below Wednesday's levels, traders said.

Following the record deal on Wednesday at $29.70, a European major offered 150,000 barrels of gas oil at 10 cents higher for October 18-22. Offers were also seen from a South Korean refiner for two 30,000-tonne parcels at around 30 cents a barrel over Singapore spot quotes fob Inchon. Traders said another refiner was offering a processing barrel of gas oil at a 50-cent premium fob Okinawa. A trader also offered an end-October cargo at a 55-cent premium fob Singapore.

Gas oil swaps for October was discussed at $28.85/$28.95 a barrel, down from the highest deal on Wednesday at $29.50. Jet fuel was actively offered, reflecting abundant supplies. A major started at $30.40 but lowered it by 5 cents for an end-October cargo. Another offer was seen at $30.10, with another major bidding at $29.75 for end October/early November. An Indonesian trader also offerd fob jet for October at a $50-cent premium. Traders said while gas oil and jet demand are soft, jet is weaker. This would prompt refiners to optimise gas oil output in a week or two, they said. Nepal would issue a tender over the weekend to buy a cargo each of November kerosene and gas oil.
Naphtha was largely unchanged from Wednesday's close with October swaps quoted at $21.10/21.30. Gasoline edged up with a buyer seen for 95 octane at $23.60 per barrel fob Singapore.

Traders said that Thai Oil's tender to sell 240,000 barrels of 95-octane unleaded cargo lifting in October was sold at a small premium to Singapore quotes on an fob Thailand basis but was not confirmed.
A 92-octane cargo was traded between two Japanese trading houses at $23.05 per barrel fob Singapore.
Fuel oil rose $1 a tonne on continued buying interests to $119. But nothing was traded. --Singapore newsroom (65-870-3084)
